generator.rank_function: SHA256 compact UTF8 JSON array [protocol_id, seed, tag, ...integer_parts]; lexicographic bytes, integer tuple breaks ties
generator.channel_operation_mapping: rank four displacement indices with tag map,c,index; assign in rank order to private slots j=0..3
generator.cue_id: full SHA256 rank with tag cue,c,x,y
generator.operation_id: full SHA256 rank with tag op,c,j
generator.outcome_id: same as cue_id for the reached coordinate
generator.training: two complete passes over all training pairs in rank order train,pass,c,x,y,j
generator.primary_closed: per channel and private slot, first 16 heldout pairs by rank closed,c,x,y,j
generator.primary_seen: per channel and private slot, first 16 training pairs by rank seen,c,x,y,j
generator.test_order: rank all selected cases by test,phase,c,x,y,j; phase is evaluator-only
generator.operation_menu: rank opaque operation IDs by menu,phase,case_index,j independently of correct slot
generator.goal: public reached coordinate under the evaluator's selected slot; correct slot and mapping are private
generator.interruption: every fourth scored case, one other-channel notification between cue and choice; no outcome evidence; identical FIFO transport for all arms

public: four opaque operation IDs in menu order
actual own operation and outcome coordinate/ID when admitted
information_boundary.native_driver: copy and encode public observations only; concrete field-to-Feature mapping frozen in implementation manifest; no environment solver, goal scorer, latest-actual action mask or select_goal policy outside core
information_boundary.teachers_and_llm: disabled for native arm; forced common training actions are labelled curriculum, not native decisions

arms.policy: reviewed existing core competition selects executable opaque operation; no task solver in driver; learn actual admitted transitions
last actual outcome for (channel,cue,operation); prefer known goal match, otherwise uniform among unobserved operations, otherwise uniform all four
last observed modular displacement for (channel,operation); predict modular coordinate plus displacement; prefer goal match, otherwise uniform unobserved operations, otherwise uniform all four
first legal operation in public menu; no learning
uniform four legal operations; counter-based SHA256 randomness
exact trained native checkpoint; no persistent learning from subsequent receipts; reset task context between scored cases
native initial checkpoint; all curriculum observable but no persistent learning; no handcrafted operation semantics

execution.primary_learning: reset to identical post-training checkpoint per case; scored actual outcomes remain evaluator-only and are never admitted to any policy; no learning across primary cases
execution.fallback: native abstention or generic uniform fallback allowed; counted as failure or fallback separately; fallback never credits useful Gen

criteria.primary_unit: one seed's closed-case success fraction; report all eight paired seed rows
criteria.inference: operational thresholds, not a statistical equivalence claim; eight environment replications, not thousands of independent samples
criteria.candidate_wording: parity with structural control; architectural advantage not demonstrated; independent replication required
criteria.comparison_to_exact_role: descriptive better/equal/worse classification; exact-table superiority alone never suffices for candidacy

causal_intervention.condition: availability of one learned non-atomic Gen in live active competition
causal_intervention.witness_selection: before primary outcomes: earliest-created non-atomic Gen with two distinct actual curriculum receipt IDs and a path from observed cue through its operation to observed outcome; ties by creation sequence then feature chain; task is earliest originating training case; absent witness is missing functional evidence, not seed exclusion
causal_intervention.carrier: remove target from active context and deny its retrieval/expansion in the decision read path; keep base, features and evidence immutable; not a post-hoc prediction or logging mask
causal_intervention.controls: same canonical checkpoint, input and random variates; no learning during paired probes; enumerate all alternative live sufficient routes
causal_intervention.success: available/sham/restored select a correct nonfallback operation via target Gen; blocked removes that causal path and changes operation or yields wait/abstain; target unavailable read counter is nonzero; base unchanged; other sufficient routes absent for a necessity claim
causal_intervention.redundancy: another sufficient Gen preserves action: report redundancy, do not claim single-Gen necessity or select a later witness after inspecting outcomes
causal_intervention.scope: local mechanism knockout; neither natural cessation nor the entire twelve-link cycle

cases: withheld actual is unknown with no negative support update
actual observed mismatch updates support for contradicted prediction and affects subsequent competition
other-channel interruption retains pending task without negative evidence; continuation resumes within eight core decision steps
status_panel.selection: witness originating case; legitimate mismatching outcome obtained by changed environment mapping, never forged evidence
status_panel.missing_witness: functional panel fails; no replacement task selected from heldout outcomes

resources.overflow: stop, preserve complete prefix and receipt; INCOMPLETE, never raise cap after seeing outcomes
resources.accounting: all features, bases, context, indexes, sidecars, receipt stores, queues and driver caches; report peak RSS and actual index work separately; no equal-compute claim from equal action budgets

decision_order: NOT_READY: native source eligibility, protocol acceptance or implementation lock missing; no confirming generation

INVALID_OR_INCOMPLETE: control contract violation, leak, wrong split, corrupted audit, missing actual or resource overflow; preserve failure, no automatic retry; random sample fluctuation alone is not invalid

AC0_CANDIDATE_STRUCTURAL_PARITY: native closed mean >=0.98 and all absolute quality/causal/status/resource conditions pass and structural gap <=0.02 => parity with structural control, architectural advantage not demonstrated; independent replication required
STRUCTURAL_CONTROL_EXPLAINS: 0.80 <= native closed mean <0.98 => not a candidate; mechanism trails simple structural explanation even if better than exact table

OPERATIONAL_TIE_WITH_LITERAL_TABLE: near 0.50 and absolute mean native-exact delta <=0.02 and every seed delta <=0.05 => native behaves as literal table; conditioned trace only if causal/status evidence passes; next cessation/AC1 prerequisites, no gate pass
WORSE_THAN_LITERAL_TABLE: mean native-exact delta <=-0.10 and negative >=7 seeds => simplify/change mechanism, no further debug adapters
MIXED_OR_FUNCTIONAL_CRITERIA_FAILED: other margins or absent causal/status evidence => no candidate; bounded reviewer decision before new experiment
outputs: eight paired-seed score rows incl failures
raw archive outside git with SHA256 and download URL
candidate/failure decision and independent replication instructions

review_amendments.P1: analytic control expectations and deterministic reference-policy validation; stochastic realized scores are not required to equal their means
review_amendments.P2: explicit native >=0.98 candidate / 0.80..0.98 below structural control / literal-table tie decisions
review_amendments.P3: adaptation and post phases deferred to AC1; AC0 retains unknown/divergence/interruption
review_amendments.P4: Claude pre-data prediction approximately 0.50 recorded; encoding locked before development and not tuned after closed outcomes
review_amendments.P1_sampling_clarification: executor clarification for review: INVALID means control-policy/generator/evaluator violation, not ordinary finite-sample random fluctuation

deferred_ac1.scope: rule-change adaptation, post-adaptation transfer and unchanged-channel retention require a separate AC1 protocol

exact_table_online.closed_kind: expectation over two uniform unobserved operations

displacement_table_online.kind: deterministic learned displacement after complete curriculum

analytic_controls.sampling_rule: finite realized scores of stochastic controls need not equal 0.50 or 0.25; report realized and analytic expected values separately; no automatic INVALID from a mean deviation alone
analytic_controls.randomness_audit: verify candidate support and menu/random construction, then independently reproduce action per case; do not reroll to force an expected sample mean
